title: Invite friends
hint: Share Kiorex with people you care about. You are rewarded after a friend's first completed visit.
inviteHint: Anyone who joins with your link or code can book a doctor on Kiorex.
qrAlt: QR code of your invite link
shareText: A friend invited you to Kiorex, where you can book a visit with a doctor. Join here: {{url}}
suspended: Your invite is paused right now. Please contact support if you think this is a mistake.
emptyHint: Share your link and this page will show how many friends joined. It never shows who they are.
rewardsHint: Vouchers and credit you earned. They can only be used on Kiorex bookings.
cachedOffline: You are offline. Showing your last saved invite.
cachedOnline: We could not refresh just now. Showing your last saved invite.
noRewardsHint: When a friend you invited completes a first visit, your reward appears here.
rewardRule: Rewards can only be used on Kiorex bookings. They cannot be withdrawn, sent to someone else or exchanged for cash.
termsPlaceholder: The referral terms are being finalised and will appear here before this feature opens.

landing.title: A friend invited you to Kiorex
landing.body: Find a doctor, book a time that works and pay securely. Sign up to accept the invite.
landing.privacy: Your friend never sees your details.
landing.acceptedBody: You are all set. Book your first visit and your reward will follow once it is completed.
landing.invalidBody: It may have expired or already been used. You can still browse doctors and book.

capsLeft_one: You can still earn a reward for {{count}} more friend this year.
capsLeft_other: You can still earn rewards for {{count}} more friends this year.
revealHint: The code is shown once. After that, use this voucher from your list at checkout.
codeOnce: Write this code down now: it will not be shown again.
alreadyShown: The code was already shown. Use this voucher from your list at checkout.
